arguments.summary: A low-severity port scan alert from IP 10.0.5.14 (WS-FIN-042) targeting 10.0.4.1 escalated into a confirmed compromise involving Cobalt Strike beaconing, lateral movement, and credential abuse. The initial vector was a phishing email triggering an encoded PowerShell download from Outlook, leading to execution of an unsigned DLL via rundll32. Despite detection by EDR and IDS, response actions were not approved, allowing continued adversary activity including SMB-based lateral movement to a file server. The host WS-FIN-042 (Finance department, high criticality) is fully compromised.

timeline.description: User CORP\jsmith launched Outlook (initial access vector suspected).
Encoded PowerShell executed from Outlook process (T1566.001).
rundll32.exe loaded unsigned beacon.dll from Temp directory (T1218.011).
IDS detected Cobalt Strike beacon C2 traffic to 198.51.100.23 (T1071.001).
Failed Kerberos TGT request indicates potential credential brute-force or AS-REP roast attempt.
Successful SMB access to file server 10.0.5.50 indicates lateral movement (T1021.002).
Port scan from 10.0.5.14 to 10.0.4.1 detected (likely reconnaissance for further lateral movement).
